name: search_docs
description: Search the API documentation for an endpoint or concept

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

name: get_endpoint
description: Get full documentation for a specific API endpoint

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

name: get_changelog
description: Get recent API changes and breaking changes

arguments.name: breakingOnly
arguments.desc: Only return entries with breaking changes (default false)

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

name: list_sdks
description: List the available SDK client libraries for this API (languages, versions, and download links)

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

name: get_guide
description: Get the full content of a written guide (tutorial / conceptual doc) by its slug

arguments.name: groupSlug
arguments.desc: The guide's section slug, if it belongs to one

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

name: get_sdk_methods
description: Show how to call this API through its generated SDKs. Ready-to-use code snippets per endpoint in every supported language. Use `slug` (from list_endpoints) to focus on one endpoint, and `language` (e.g. typescript, python, go) to focus on one language.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: Focus on one SDK language (e.g. typescript, python, go). Omit for all supported languages.

arguments.name: projectId
arguments.desc: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

arguments.name: slug
arguments.desc: Focus on a single endpoint by its slug. Omit to return all endpoints.
